title: Stage representatives in the raw Kan section colimit
statement:
Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathbf{Cat}$ a diagram
[def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $V$ be a cocone whose object and arrow
cocones are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Equip each $F(j)$ with
a precoverage $P_j$, with continuous transition functors, and $V$ with a
precoverage $Q$ for which its legs are continuous [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology].
Fix $i\in J$, a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $F(i)$, and $U\in F(i)$.
For $t\in(i\downarrow J)$ put $A_t=(F(t))^{-1}G$ and $U_t=F(t)(U)$.
Let $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b)_*A_{t'}$ be transition maps. Let $B:(i\downarrow J)\to\operatorname{PSh}(V)$ have left Kan units
$\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^*B_t$ satisfying
$[\beta_t B(b)]=[\theta_b\beta_{t'}]$ as arrows at each stage object.
Let $D:(i\downarrow J)\to\mathbf{Sets}$ have isomorphisms
$E_t:D_t\simeq A_t(U_t)$.
Set $Y=V_i(U)$. Suppose $\kappa_t:D_t\to(\operatorname{colim}B)(Y)$
is the composite of $E_t$, $\beta_t$, the colimit coprojection, and transport
along $V_t(U_t)=Y$. Then every $x\in(\operatorname{colim}B)(Y)$ has the form
$\kappa_t(y)$ for some $t$ and $y\in D_t$.

proof.text: Represent a raw section in the evaluated outer colimit and then in the pointwise Kan colimit, using Types.jointly_surjective_of_isColimit and Functor.isPointwiseLeftKanExtensionOfIsLeftKanExtension. A representative is a section s at W with an arrow from V_i(U) to V_t(W).

Lift the arrow using joint surjectivity of the arrow colimit. Pass to a common stage and align its source and target by applying the filtered object-colimit equality criterion twice. Equalize the two arrows out of i to obtain a refinement b in Under i and an arrow g from the forward image of U to the forward image of W. The private helpers lift_arrow and lift_under_arrow implement this argument.

Apply theta_b to s, restrict along g, and apply E inverse. Naturality of beta and the coprojections, together with hbeta_map, identifies its kappa image with the original representative. The proof uses actual morphism composites and Arrow.mk congruence to handle endpoint transports.

lean.statement:
theorem raw_section_generators
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u))
    (β : ∀ t : Under i,
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
    (hβ : ∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t))
    (hβmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
      Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
        (B.map b).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' b).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (β t').app (op ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj X))))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (D : Under i ⥤ Type u)
    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅ ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (κ : ∀ t : Under i,
      D.obj t ⟶ (colimit B).obj (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hκ : ∀ t : Under i,
        ∃ e : (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U) =
            (V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U,
          κ t =
            (E t).hom ≫ (β t).app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)) ≫
              (colimit.ι B t).app
                (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) ≫
              eqToHom (congrArg (fun X => (colimit B).obj (op X)) e)) :
    ∀ x : (colimit B).obj (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)),
      ∃ (t : Under i) (y : D.obj t), κ t y = x
